lead_raw_text:
The structure of Gd8Zn4Rh4 (reduced formula Gd2ZnRh) crystallizes in the cubic space group Fm-3m (No. 225), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows each Gd center has 10 geometric neighbors (2 Rh, 8 Zn), while each Rh and Zn center has 8 Gd neighbors, all with a body-centered-cubic-like local arrangement at a uniform neighbor distance of 2.9961 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts show Gd–Gd polyhedra sharing corner, edge, and face types, while Rh–Zn polyhedra share corners and faces.
